People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Hugh Walpole, the author, died 1941 (Wikidata Q548004). Citizenship: United Kingdom, New Zealand.

First publication of the text used: 1919 (SE colophon: 'The Secret City was published in 1919 by Hugh Walpole.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: works published before 1931 are in the public domain in the United States. The colophon dates this work to 1919. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the same.
- Country of origin (not stated by the colophon): the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for this death, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 1 January 2012. The last person to die among the people whose words are in the text is Hugh Walpole, in 1941.
